messages:
pat_billing: Heads-up: vendor invoice from ComputeSupplies came in for $48,762 but the PO was for $42,000. Vendor claims change order for extra GPUs shipped. Need approval to pay the difference or dispute.

suresh_sales: Were extra GPUs ordered by Eng? I didn't approve any change orders.

amelia_finance: Can we get the change order doc and receiving report? If goods received match invoice and PO change wasn't approved, we still owe but need escalation. If unapproved, dispute and hold payment pending docs.

derek_legal: If PO terms require written change orders, vendor may be out of contract. We should ask for a signed change order or proof of written authorization. Do not pay until we verify.

billing_bot: Reminder: policy PO-variants: any invoice >10% above PO requires PO amendment or AP hold. Create AP ticket #AP-3344.

pat_billing: AP ticket created #AP-3344. Vendor sent email with attached packing list but no signed change order. They claim verbal approval from an infra manager.

mike_ceo: If infra needed hardware urgently and vendor shipped, we should balance partner relationship vs controls. But we need to protect the company. Amelia, propose a remediation path.

amelia_finance: Propose: 1) Pay 50% of the difference as interim to keep vendor cooperative, 2) withhold remaining 50% pending signed change order or proof of authorization, 3) initiate internal review and retrain infra managers on PO controls. Seek VP-Finance sign-off.

suresh_sales: I agree with interim payment to maintain supply chain. Also want a clause in vendor agreement to require written change orders moving forward.

derek_legal: We'll draft amendment to vendor terms to require signed change orders and impose restocking/return options if unauthorized shipments occur. Also recommend vendor credit memo if they can't produce signed change order.

billing_bot: Action created: AP-3344 assigned to pat_billing. Policy attached.

amelia_finance: I'll request VP-Finance approval for interim 50% payment. If approved, we can net off once documentation provided.

pat_billing: Vendor confirmed receipt of partial payment terms. Awaiting docs. Will update ticket.
